verdict.rationale: Gusto's own agent-facing CLI ships a payroll-prep skill that puts per-cycle inputs onto a draft payroll for review. It also offers --dry-run previews and an agent-mode confirmation gate that keeps a human approving writes, and the CLI cannot submit a payroll itself. The API exposes unprocessed regular payrolls and a contractor payment preview endpoint that returns submission_blockers. However, nothing documents a regular-payroll preview/calculation endpoint or any anomaly detection that flags unusual payroll amounts for review. Missing for 10: documented regular-payroll preview/calculate API, anomaly or outlier detection surfaced to the reviewer, hands-on or independent corroboration of an agent-driven preview-and-review flow.
